_comment: Progress tracker for the 66 finalised supplier styles. Source photos live in Drive under 'supplier photos' (folder 1ABavj7cy3cp0GWCWP0oR_Pa_fCBTcYaF), shared with shopatnaira@gmail.com — the account the Drive connector authenticates as. Each SKU gets the same three frames as the Gilded Hour line: ecom on the cream plaster block, worn on its category's model plate, and a different-angle frame.
_pipeline: Drive files are access-restricted, so they cannot be fetched by URL. Route: Google_Drive download_file_content (base64 lands on disk, never in context) -> base64 decode -> higgsfield media_upload for presigned URLs -> curl PUT the bytes -> use the returned media_id as IMAGE 1.
_source_photo_note: Supplier photos come in three kinds and the prompt must handle each: spec sheets with printed measurements and callout arrows (strip all text and annotation, keep only the object), on-model shots (discard the model, skin and background entirely, keep only the jewellery), and plain packshots. Printed dimensions on the spec sheets are the authoritative size for that SKU.

yiwu_jd.layout: one folder per SKU, numbered photos inside

sizing_audit._method: Every worn frame is checked against a body feature of known size: a finger is ~16mm across at the base, an adult earlobe ~18mm tall, and the collarbone sits at a known depth. On the plaster block a piece has no reference object, so scale drift is invisible there; on the body the skin is the ruler. That is why the audit runs on the worn frames.
_sizing_sources_in_order_of_authority: printed dimensions on the supplier spec sheet (exact; available for 5 Yiss Fera SKUs)
the size guide published on nairaflore.com (see sizing.md)
proportion read directly off the supplier packshot
sizing_audit._alibaba: The live listings could not be reached. Tried three independent routes - curl through the environment proxy, headless Chromium through the proxy, and a web-fetch service - and all three return a captcha or an empty page. Public search does not index the private wholesale codes (JDB2409013, E19263B and the rest). If a listing's spec panel is pasted in, the real numbers can replace the derived ones.
